scope: All units read: translation and word glosses against the Telugu text. The text was not compared with the source. A folk text with several dialect or corrupt words.

items.issue: నరుడా was “O Man-lion”; the word is “O Man”.
ఓనంబితడు, కైనంబితడు was “the sacred syllable … our one recourse” in the translation and “the beginning … the end” in the gloss.
items.change: Translation aligned with the gloss and marked uncertain.

items.issue: Three words are uncertain to me: ఓనంబు and కైనంబు (unit 2; glossed “the beginning”, “the end”) and గోళజంబు (unit 3; glossed “the one born of the pillar”, left out of the translation). Unit 7 has ఊర్హిన ఊర్హునకు and నారశింహోనకు, which look like spoken forms.
options: A. Leave the renderings as they are, marked uncertain.
B. You supply the sense as you know it from recitation.
C. You have a printed copy to correct the text against.
items.recommend: B or C: this is an orally transmitted text and you are the better witness.
